reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Allow templating ServiceAccount annotations by running the built-in Helm `tpl` function on keys and values, to aid with workload identity configuration", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: ServiceAccount annotation keys and values are now run through the built-in Helm tpl function, so any {{ ... }} template expressions they contain are rendered by Helm instead of being written as literal text.
consequence.remediation: Verify that any ServiceAccount annotation keys or values containing {{ ... }} expressions are intended to be rendered as Helm templates rather than emitted literally.

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 runs the built-in Helm tpl function on ServiceAccount annotation keys and values, so the Helm chart's ServiceAccount annotations now support Helm templating, to aid with workload identity configuration.
